verdict.rationale: Conductor's HTTP API and the dbosctl CLI document managing members, roles, and API keys, so credentials can be issued programmatically, which suits an agent workflow. Nothing in the evidence shows that those API keys can be scoped to specific permissions, apps, or operations. Roles are mentioned only alongside members, not keys. missing for 10: documented per-key scoping or least-privilege permissions, agent-specific credential guidance, key expiry/rotation details, independent or hands-on corroboration.
